title: Welcome to the Arclight Project
text:
Arclight is an open-source eco-epidemiology engine designed for use by public health officials, epidemiologists, clinicians, and academic researchers exploring the potential for infectious disease outbreaks in novel populations and locations.
Disease risk is a dynamic state space governed by environmental physics, molecular evolution, and transmission networks. The Arclight engine provides proactive epidemiological intelligence by mapping the emergence probability landscape within this phase space.

title: About the Developer
text:
Hi, I’m Matt Scruggs, designer and maintainer of the Arclight engine. I’m an epidemiologist and data science professional passionate about solving humanity’s toughest problems with our best technology.
In my 20 years of data science experience, I’ve designed solutions for the automotive, consumer retail, insurance, banking, pharmaceutical, and healthcare industries, and worked with C-level executives to turn strategic imperatives into operational tools and capabilities.
Complex domains and regulatory environments are familiar territory. I’ve built several teams and data science departments from the ground up, focusing on scrappy, high-ROI solutions to prove value, which turn into polished and reliable enterprise assets.
I hold a Master of Science in Data Analytics, a Master of Public Health, and Post-Graduate Certifications in Machine Learning and Epidemiology.
